comparison.objective: Candidate depins an electrical terminal; record mounts the last section of a bicycle tire bead.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid blade access and wire-tool withdrawal versus distributed bimanual bead depression, slack propagation, and rim insertion without a lever.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact release but lacks measured force/damage thresholds. Record requires bead seating supported by sufficient center-channel engagement and penalizes lever use or bead/rim failure.
comparison.reason: Rigid latch manipulation and distributed deformable bead management test unrelated abilities.
